description:
Every GTA 6 secret worth finding, pinned on Rockstar's official Leonida map: where each one is, when to go and what to look for. The egg tower, the UFO, Bigfoot (the Skunk Ape), the giant crab, Cool Dog, Dexter's apartment, Paul Walker's car, the NPC who knows it's a game, Arthur Morgan's hat, a Red Dead book, Tommy Vercetti's portal, plus the first shoe store. No story spoilers. Each spot is in at least two launch-week guides; where they disagree, we say so.

segments.headline: EVERY SECRET
segments.chapter: Intro: 12 secrets on the official map
segments.text: Every GTA 6 secret worth finding, pinned on Rockstar's official map. Twelve spots, where they are, and when to go.

segments.headline: 1: EGG TOWER
segments.text: One: a literal Easter egg. A nest of painted eggs on top of a tall radio mast in Bluegrass, north of Hamlet. Some guides say South Vice-Dale. The climb takes about seven minutes.

segments.headline: 2: THE UFO
segments.text: Two: the UFO. Drive the country roads east of Port Gellhorn, alone, after two AM, from Chapter Two. Look for an abandoned car with flashing lights. It doesn't happen every night.

segments.headline: 3: BIGFOOT
segments.text: Three: Bigfoot. The Skunk Ape shows up around Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet. Take the lakeside road and look for a deer carcass. Night is best.

segments.headline: 4: GIANT CRAB
segments.text: Four: a giant crab. Take a boat into Gullet Marsh in Pelican Valley, find the abandoned research outpost and turn the power back on. The password is CLEAVES.

segments.headline: 5: COOL DOG
segments.text: Five: Cool Dog. Swim far from land and boats, most guides say around Gambit Bay, and a dog on a jet ski comes to rescue you. Give it time.

segments.headline: 6: DEXTER
segments.text: Six: Dexter's apartment. A light-blue building with a spiral staircase on Washington Island. The door stays locked, but his boat waits at a dock to the west.

segments.headline: 7: PAUL WALKER
segments.text: Seven: Paul Walker's car. A green tuner styled like his Eclipse from the first Fast and Furious, in a villa garage on Vespucci Island. Guides say use the side door.

segments.headline: 8: SELF-AWARE NPC
segments.chapter: 8. The NPC who knows it's a game (Belville)
segments.text: Eight: the man who thinks he lives in a video game. His notes are in a garage in Belville, at the house from a photo hidden in San Andreas' 2021 remaster.

segments.headline: 9: ARTHUR'S HAT
segments.text: Nine: Arthur Morgan's hat, at a yard sale in southern Port Gellhorn, from Chapter Two. Guides list different prices.

segments.headline: 10: RED DEAD BOOK
segments.text: Ten: a Red Dead book. Inside Jacob's Tavern in Millport there's a Western novel about a cowboy from New Austin.

segments.headline: 11: VERCETTI PORTAL
segments.text: Eleven: Tommy Vercetti's portal. Twelve switches, from the Badger radio tower in Key Lento to the Turtle Head power station, between seven PM and six AM. No fast travel.

segments.headline: 12: SHOE STORE
segments.text: And a bonus for shoppers: the first shoe store, Flip Flop House, right off Sunbelt Highway in Key Lento.

segments.headline: WHICH ONE FIRST?
segments.text: Every spot is on our interactive map at vicereplay dot com. Which one are you hunting first? Tell me the number, and subscribe for the next ones.
